post.description: Explicit chosen-name registration with fresh verified initData. Retry using the same commandId and fresh initData. Telegram identity and registration completion are idempotent even across different command IDs; completed accounts retain their names and handles. Shares issuance IP/identity rate budgets. startParam is signed opaque routing context, not membership or an arbitrary redirect URL. No session, cookie or credential is issued. Names are plain text requiring escaped rendering. A failed response after commit may leave registration complete; retry recovers it.
